data_fields.name: relative_step
data_fields.donor_constant: values of 0 or more add to the stored id; puzzle uses 1

data_fields.name: required_count
data_fields.donor_constant: 14 books (threshold function not read; the number appears in the script name and comment)

best_idea: Give each interactable one step pointer and one counter in a single flat ledger; scripts move the pointer (absolute or relative) and count separately, and the trigger reloads its pointer from the ledger when its zone loads.
decision_why: Frankendom wants one ledger and zones as data; a trigger that holds one step pointer and separate counters is the smallest shape that gives quests with steps without a quest engine. Split absolute from relative writes, keep counters apart from steps, and make a keep-write from another zone read the stored value. Lua dialogue and the Lua runtime are not taken.
acceptance: In a zone a quest NPC moves from step 1 to step 2 only when the server ledger count reaches the zone's required number; a server test asserts that a keep-write from another zone leaves the stored slot unchanged and that a count never moves a step pointer.
